deck_context.source_summary: Class 31, week 7, September 28 2026. Traditional AEM Sites. Technical publication tracing in Cloud and local SDK. English PNG slides, Spanish guide.
canonical_facts: Sling Content Distribution moves Cloud content through an external distribution service.
publish agent is enabled by default; preview is separate when configured.
persisted queue cleared means durable storage on Publish; fully published cleared means live on all Publish pods.
ReplicationStatus isActivated is last action, isPending is queue state, isDelivered is log-derived and not physical presence.
Use getStatusForAgent for Preview versus Publish; preview-only does not update general status.
Local SDK uses a classic replication agent, not the same Cloud SCD queues.
Verify exact page and asset paths on Publish. End before Apache/Dispatcher, covered in Class 32.
